sources.excerpt: Every expensive stage is covered by the supervisor.

inductive Outcome where
  | qualified | invalid | unsupported | unknownResource | cancelled | unsupportedPolicy
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Claim where
  | derivation | completeClosure | absence | shadowReady
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

-- Necessary permission, not sufficient proof of an individual logical claim.
def ClaimPermitted (outcome : Outcome) (_claim : Claim) : Prop := outcome = .qualified

criteria.criterion: Every expensive stage is covered by the supervisor.
Actual enforcement mode and observed reason are recorded.
Killed/incomplete work produces no qualified receipt or application.

decisions.decision: Supervise decoding through final inspection in one process group; parent validates only small operator policy and the bounded returned envelope.
Required memory cannot silently become advisory; cgroup v2 delegation and effective controls must be proven before an enforcing worker is released.
decisions.basis: Current host probe and P01 policy variants.

decisions.decision: Observed advisory RSS exhaustion remains advisory; report kernel OOM separately only when actual cgroup events prove it.
decisions.basis: P06 memory semantics and supplied claim ceilings.
